answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 72 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a nebula bet on surviving 72 epochs of grading, and every willow settlement recomputes the basalt schedule, so a hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 12 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
